title: Burak & Fiete (2009), Hafting et al. (2005) & Stensola et al. (2012) Continuous Attractor Entorhinal Grid-Cell Hexagonal Lattice, Velocity Path Integration & Discrete Dorso-Ventral Scale Ratio sqrt(2)

primary_papers.citation: Burak Y, Fiete IR (2009) Accurate Path Integration in Continuous Attractor Network Models of Grid Cells. PLoS Comput. Biol. 5(2):e1000291
Hafting T, Fyhn M, Molden S, Moser MB, Moser EI (2005) Microstructure of a spatial map in the entorhinal cortex. Nature 436(7052):801-806
Stensola H, Stensola T, Solstad T, Froland K, Moser MB, Moser EI (2012) The entorhinal grid map is discretized. Nature 492(7427):72-78
Brandon MP, Bogaard AR, Libby CP, Connerney MA, Gupta K, Hasselmo ME (2011) Reduction of Theta Rhythm Dissociates Grid Cell Spatial Periodicity from Directional Tuning. Science 332(6029):595-599

governing_equations.burak_fiete_cann_pde: tau * ds_theta(x, t)/dt + s_theta(x, t) = [ sum_{theta'} int W_0(x - x' - l * e_hat(theta')) s_{theta'}(x', t) dx' + B * (1 + alpha * v(t) . e_hat(theta)) ]_+
governing_equations.surround_inhibition_kernel: W_0(Delta_x) = a * exp(-gamma * ||Delta_x||^2) - exp(-beta * ||Delta_x||^2),   gamma = 1.05 * beta
governing_equations.fourier_ring_dispersion: W_hat_0(k) = (pi * a / gamma) * exp(-k^2 / (4 * gamma)) - (pi / beta) * exp(-k^2 / (4 * beta)),   k_c = sqrt(4 * beta * gamma / (gamma - beta) * ln(gamma / (a * beta)))
governing_equations.resonant_triad_selection: k_1 + k_2 + k_3 = 0 with |k_i| = k_c at 120 deg (60 deg hexagonal lattice) maximizes quadratic rectification energy int [u(x)]_+^3 dx over 90 deg square planforms
governing_equations.linear_velocity_path_integration: d(Phi_bump)/dt = c_v * alpha * l * v(t)  ==>  Delta_Phi_bump(T) = c_v * alpha * l * (x_animal(T) - x_animal(0))
governing_equations.stensola_discrete_module_scaling: lambda_{m+1} / lambda_m = sqrt(2) approx 1.4142  ==>  lambda_{m+1}^2 / lambda_m^2 = 2 (discrete area doubling across M1..M4 dorso-ventral MEC modules)

experimental_regimes.description: Dorsal MEC Layer II Module M1 (lambda_1 = 38 cm, beta = 0.064): 4-subpopulation (N, S, E, W) Burak-Fiete continuous attractor network spontaneously forms a 60 deg hexagonal bump lattice and integrates 2D foraging velocity with high hexagonal gridness score G_60 > 1.0
Intermediate-dorsal MEC Module M2 (lambda_2 = 54 cm approx 38 * sqrt(2)): scale-expanded surround-inhibition kernel beta_2 = beta_1 / 2 doubles unit-cell area (lambda_2^2 / lambda_1^2 approx 2.02)
Intermediate-ventral MEC Module M3 (lambda_3 = 76 cm = 2 * lambda_1): third discrete Stensola et al. (2012) module with scale ratio lambda_3 / lambda_2 = 1.4074

Ventral MEC Module M4 (lambda_4 = 108 cm = 2 * lambda_2): fourth discrete Stensola et al. (2012) module with scale ratio lambda_4 / lambda_3 = 1.4211 and cumulative ratio lambda_4 / lambda_1 = 2.8421 approx 2*sqrt(2)

Orthogonal 90 deg 2-mode square lattice control (k_x, k_y without 120 deg resonant triad closure k_1+k_2+k_3=0): yields negative 60 deg gridness score G_60 < 0 and positive 90 deg rotational symmetry, demonstrating quadratic triad selection of 60 deg hexagonal planforms

Brandon et al. (2011) / Burak & Fiete (2009) medial-septum muscimol inactivation / symmetric weight ablation control (l = 0, alpha = 0): neural sheet still self-organizes a static hexagonal bump attractor on the cortical sheet, but bump phase is pinned (Delta_Phi = 0) and single-neuron spatial arena rate map loses hexagonal periodicity
